goal: Daemon lifecycle: gad daemon start/status/stop/logs/restart per-singleton + crash-loop detection. Today gad system start is fire-and-forget (no log capture, no crash-loop guard, supervisor only intervenes if itself alive). Required: each singleton writes structured stderr to .planning/.daemons/<id>.log; crash-loop detector (3 deaths in <60s = circuit-breaker, mark daemon as 'failing' in gad sitrep + refuse auto-restart until operator clears); gad daemon logs <id> --tail for live debug; gad daemon restart <id> for one-shot restart. Connects to GLOBAL-D-315 (one-button lifecycle) + GLOBAL-D-319 (Kael owns substrate).
